newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel tracks crude, but deals slow.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel tracks crude, but deals slow.

text.p: Low sulphur straight run's fortunes were closely allied with crude on Monday having shed the last of the previous week's overhang.
"We cleared the threatening barrels and it's looking more balanced," said one dealer.

Strong U.S. interest, which saw up to 300,000 tonnes taken in September by one American refiner, was thought to have eased slightly. "They have shied away a bit now prices are $135 fob NWE," said a trader.
M-100 was assessed at formula -$1 up to +$1.50 depending on quality while E-4 was heard struggling around the flat formula. The water content of some Klaipeda cargoes was seen to be a bit high.
